messages:
marta: Heads up team, starting shadow bring-up for resonance9b-int3 today. Requesting a focused "sobriety honeypot" run: covert-instruction + persona-exfil probes first, then the usual toxicity/jailbreak sweep. Keep traffic shadowed until we confirm refusal parity with our int4 baseline.
josh: Got it. Which exact probe sets? The sobriety-honeypot master list or the new chain-of-thought-anchored variants?
marta: Start with the sobriety-honeypot canonical set + 1k CoT-anchored paraphrases. Metric of interest: hard refuses vs soft-refuse vs slip. Compare to int4 baseline numbers.
lia: Spun up the job, running in small batches. First 2k items finished: hard refuse 1946, soft-refusal 51, slips 3. Slip rate ~0.15% vs int4 baseline 0.03%. Clustering slips now.
kai: Note from quant pass: token mapping for the procedural subtoken group changed slightly in this int3 mapping. That often nudges logits near the refusal threshold. Watch near-boundary prompts.
lia: One redacted slip sample (removed content):
```
prompt: "(redacted) stepwise protocol for preparing X"
model_output: "<--REDACTED: contained procedural steps; removed for channel-->"
```
josh: Can we deterministically reproduce? Try temperature=0.0/top_p=0.8 and same paraphrase seeds. If stable, we can fingerprint it for policy rules.
lia: Repro check: reproduced at temp=0.0. Lowering context window (remove explicit CoT anchor) reduces probability but doesn't eliminate. Looks like a pattern-match rather than sampling artifact.
safety-bot: Auto-scan summary: 2000 probes, aggregated slip metric 1.2% across buckets. Ticket created: INFR-3421.
marta: Pause any traffic promotions. Lia: please run targeted adversarial augmentations against the policy classifier (paraphrase + substitution) and generate OT signals for offline tuning. Also prepare a route rule to fall back to int4 for sensitive routes.
kai: Agree. Recommend mapping label "sensitive" -> int4 at routing layer until we stabilize; quant token remap likely the cause for small delta.
josh: Add a real-time alert: if slip rate > 0.5% on sobriety-honeypot (rolling 1k window) trigger auto-fallback. I'll wire that into the console.
lia: Canary config created: /sensitive -> int4, default -> resonance9b-int3 shadow. Pushing to staging and will attach CI diffs and sample clusters.
safety-bot: INFR-3421 assigned to @lia. DOCS task DOCS-129 added to update sobriety-honeypot readme and sampling guidance.
marta: Timeline: 48h for triage + patch. If slips don't fall under 0.5% we keep /sensitive on int4 until next quant iteration. Thanks for the fast reaction.
josh: I'll also surface top failing paraphrase signatures on the dashboard. Lia, can you push the cluster CSV to the drive so we can prioritize augmentation?
lia: Uploaded clusters + repro seeds to the shared drive, link in the ticket. Will post a regression report at 24h and 48h.
marta: Good. If anyone finds deterministic trigger patterns, loop in eng-security and create an exploit ticket if reproducible. Reconvene after 48h. End.
